<description>
**Problem:** Wallet encryption ignores a failed database rewrite after encrypted key records have been committed.
Old plaintext key material can remain in unused pages without a warning.

**Fix:** Log the cleanup failure while preserving the successful encryption result.
The warning advises moving funds to a newly created wallet before relying on at-rest encryption.
</description>

<commits>
2683b3bb57 test: characterize encryption rewrite failure

Show that `EncryptWallet()` still returns true and leaves usable encrypted keys when the final database rewrite fails.
A successful rewrite is the control, and a TODO marks the missing warning for the following fix.

5f7f18b07a wallet: warn when encryption cleanup fails

Encrypted key records have already been committed when the final database rewrite runs.
A failed rewrite can leave old plaintext key bytes in unused pages, so log a warning while keeping the successful encryption result.
</commits>
